_comment: The Draw Mask panel of the emtk app, drawn by emtk.view_form over ndxplorer.app.features.selection.DrawMaskModel inside the plot-control dock's 'draw_mask' custom section. The same controls as the Qt window's widgetMaskDrawing (plot_control.ui): Enable drawing, Draw/Erase, Cat, Clear, Load Mask, Save Mask, Brush, Apply.

sections.label: Enable drawing
sections.description: Enable/disable drawing on the 2-D plot. While on, the left button paints instead of dragging a rectangle gate.
Paint the category, or erase back to unpainted.

sections.label: Cat:
sections.description: Category/class ID for drawing (1-255): the one the brush paints and Apply turns into a gate.

buttons.label: Load Mask
buttons.description: Load a mask from an integer TIFF (one label per bin, the map's binning).

buttons.label: Save Mask
buttons.description: Save the mask as an integer TIFF.

buttons.label: Apply
buttons.description: Add the painted category as a mask gate in the Selection table.
